text:
Noah Rivera: Kickoff for marketplace onboarding + hardware partner (EdgeNest). Need to finalize: EULA PDF, hero screenshots (3 sizes), AMIs + GCP images + Azure managed image id, appliance OVA/upgrade path, SKU rows, trial entitlements, and EdgeNest co-sell blurb. Who takes what?

Eleni Park: I can coordinate images and appliance OVA. Will produce AMIs (x86/arm64) and a signed checksum for the OVA. Need the staging publisher IDs and any validation token.

Marcus Lee: Product: propose SKUs: RedwoodInference-API, RedwoodInference-Dedicated, RedwoodInference-Appliance. Trial: 30 days, 75k token cap, 15 rps. Will add pricing tiers (hourly + monthly commit).

Priya Singh: Legal: will upload EULA + trademark release once marketing signs. For EdgeNest we must use "listed with EdgeNest" wording (not joint). Also draft KMS/telemetry lines: BYOK supported for Dedicated/Private/Appliance; hosted uses Redwood keys.

Noah Rivera: EdgeNest note: they require an appliance compatibility matrix (CPU, RAM, disk) and an install script that validates license key. Eleni please add that to the OVA.

Eleni Park: Copy. Will add /etc/marketplace-validate and a helper script /usr/local/bin/edge-install.sh that checks hardware and writes validation.json. ETA images Thu EOD.

Marcus Lee: Also add a short SI blurb for the listing: "EdgeNest provides deployment and on-prem support for the Appliance SKU." Priya to confirm legal phrasing.

Priya Singh: Confirmed. Also attaching privacy snippet: "We collect anonymized telemetry for reliability; no PII exported. Customers may request data export or opt-out for Dedicated/Private."

MarketplaceBot: Created ticket MP-5235: "marketplace intake - redwood inference (EdgeNest)" assigned partnerships. https://tickets.redwood.example/MP-5235

Noah Rivera: Actions: Eleni = images + OVA + checksums, Marcus = pricing rows + SKU metadata, Priya = EULA + EdgeNest language. Target: submit intake by next Tue COB.

Eleni Park: + will post IDs here when ready.

Marcus Lee: + will draft pricing this afternoon.

Priya Singh: + uploading EULA after marketing sign-off.

Noah Rivera: Thanks all. If EdgeNest asks for additional artifacts (kernel modules, drivers), escalate to infra and tag me.
